value.rationale: The graph family is a canonical dense clustered network and the majority-reversal probability is a natural information-aggregation statistic. A positive 8.77 percent sign-reversal limit persists despite consensus tending to probability one; meanwhile exponentially many two-cycle orbits have vanishing total basin probability of order n^-1/2. The coexistence of those exact finite and asymptotic effects is structurally motivated and not a reparameterized textbook period-two theorem.
